display_name: Eugenius, father of Mary called Marinos

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 12 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Ευγένιος», with the rank word left off.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Ευγένιος»

attestations.note: His page prints no life: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίου του Οσίου». He is kept for his daughter's sake, and the only fact about him anywhere on the day — that he had been left a widower and fled to a monastery with her — is on her page and not his.
